ordinal_word.description: Render a numerical rank as an English ordinal word; matched control renders same rank as a cardinal word.

product_sign.description: Identify positive or negative sign of a product of signed integers; matched control asks even/odd number of factors.

weekday_offset.description: Compute the weekday a given number of days after a named weekday; matched control verbalizes the offset number.

fraction_role.description: Name whether a specified integer in a fraction is its numerator or denominator; control classifies the same specified integer as even/odd.

month_number.description: Convert an integer month number to its English month name; matched control writes the number as a cardinal word.

comparative_adjective.description: Produce regular English comparative adjective; matched control produces the unchanged adjective.

compass_opposite.description: Retrieve opposite cardinal direction; matched control copies cardinal direction in same format.

roman_numeral.description: Convert small Arabic integers to Roman numerals; matched control copies Arabic number.
